-- raw up to 2 days, agg_15min beyond, one value per (CET) day beyond 60 days
WITH q AS (SELECT $__from / 1000 AS f, $__to / 1000 AS t, $__interval_ms / 1000 AS i),
src AS (
  SELECT v.name, x.ts, x.value, max(q.i, v.log_s) AS b
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN raw x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('TEMP_KIDROOM_C', 'TEMP_DOWNSTAIRS_C') AND q.t - q.f <= 172800
  UNION ALL
  SELECT v.name, x.ts, x.value, CASE WHEN q.t - q.f > 5184000 THEN 86400 ELSE max(q.i, 900) END
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN agg_15min x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('TEMP_KIDROOM_C', 'TEMP_DOWNSTAIRS_C') AND q.t - q.f > 172800
)
SELECT CASE WHEN b >= 86400 THEN ts - (ts + 3600) % 86400 ELSE ts - ts % b END AS time,
       name, AVG(value) AS value
FROM src
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Light on-time per day (hours)
panels.description: Intervals with value > 0 between consecutive event rows, per local day

targets.rawQueryText:
-- hours on per local day, from events
WITH q AS (SELECT $__from / 1000 AS f, $__to / 1000 AS t, $__interval_ms / 1000 AS i),
days(d0, d1) AS (
  SELECT s, CAST(strftime('%s', date(s, 'unixepoch', 'localtime', '+1 day'), 'utc') AS INTEGER) FROM (SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(q.f, 'unixepoch', 'localtime'), 'utc') AS INTEGER) AS s FROM q)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d1, CAST(strftime('%s', date(d1, 'unixepoch', 'localtime', '+1 day'), 'utc') AS INTEGER) FROM days, q WHERE d1 < q.t
),
ev AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN substr(v.name, 1, 9) = 'ST_LIGHT_' THEN substr(v.name, 10) ELSE v.name END AS name, x.ts, x.value, LEAD(x.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY x.var_id ORDER BY x.ts) AS te
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN events x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts < q.t
       AND x.ts >= COALESCE((SELECT MAX(e.ts) FROM events e WHERE e.var_id = v.id
                              AND e.ts <= (SELECT MIN(d0) FROM days)), 0)
  WHERE v.name IN ('ST_LIGHT_WASHBASIN', 'ST_LIGHT_KITCHEN_COUNTER', 'ST_LIGHT_LOFT_WEST', 'ST_LIGHT_LOFT_EAST_1', 'ST_LIGHT_LOFT_EAST_2', 'ST_LIGHT_BEDROOM_SOUTH', 'ST_LIGHT_BEDROOM_NORTH', 'ST_LIGHT_BATHROOM', 'ST_LIGHT_STAIR_STEPS', 'ST_LIGHT_STAIRS', 'ST_LIGHT_HALLWAY', 'ST_LIGHT_LIVING_ROOM', 'ST_LIGHT_DINING_ROOM', 'ST_LIGHT_KITCHEN', 'ST_LIGHT_EXTERIOR_HOUSE', 'ST_LIGHT_EXTERIOR_WS', 'ST_LIGHT_KOLARNA', 'ST_LIGHT_SKLEP')
),
iv AS (
  SELECT name, ts, COALESCE(te, MIN(q.t, CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER))) AS te FROM ev, q WHERE value > 0
)
SELECT d.d0 AS time, iv.name, SUM(MIN(iv.te, d.d1) - MAX(iv.ts, d.d0)) / 3600.0 AS value
FROM days d JOIN iv ON iv.ts < d.d1 AND iv.te > d.d0
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
